name: opendj-desktop-electron
description: Open DJ desktop shell on Electron: boots the bundled engine and opens a Chromium window onto it. Phase 21, beside the Tauri shell until cutover.

scripts.pack:dir: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir --mac --arm64 && node scripts/verify-pack.mjs && node scripts/read-fuses.mjs "out/mac-arm64/Open DJ.app/Contents/Frameworks/Electron Framework.framework/Electron Framework"
scripts.pack:dir:linux: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs && electron-builder --dir --linux --publish never
scripts.pack:dir:win: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/require-payload.mjs && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs && electron-builder --dir --win --x64 -c.win.signExecutable=false
scripts.pack:win: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs && node scripts/pack-win.mjs

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Open DJ lists your audio devices, briefly listens to auto-calibrate headphone cue latency, and records your set from the input you pick when you press Record. Audio stays on this Mac and is never sent anywhere.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Open DJ finds your B2B partner's laptop and shares tempo and beat with Ableton Link apps on your local network. Nothing leaves your network.
